title: Road to bigger arms: 19 inches or bust!
summary: He tapes his roughly 17-17.5 inch arms and sets a natural 19-inch goal with no deadline. His left arm is biceps-dominant, his right triceps-dominant, and overall his triceps lag, so most new mass should come from the triceps.

claims.claim: His arms measure about 17 inches (one arm about 17.5 flexed) and his goal is 19 inches, done naturally, with no deadline.
He will post all his arm training and make an update video on reaching 18 inches.
His left arm is biceps-dominant while his right arm is triceps-dominant with much more triceps long head.
Overall his triceps are dwarfed by his biceps, so most of the mass toward 19 inches should come from the triceps.
Measure arms flexed with the tape pulled as tight as possible.
He picked 19 inches because 20 inches is the mythical arm number.
